findings.claim: The requirement says MessagePack attributes on T are honoured when present. Contractless mode should apply only when T has no `[DataContract]` or `[MessagePackObject]`. The collector never inspects T's attributes. With no surrogate it always calls `CreateContractlessMembers`, so it serializes every public read-write member under its name as a string key. As a result, `[MessagePackObject]`/`[Key]`/`[IgnoreMember]` and `[DataContract]`/`[DataMember]` on T are ignored: `[IgnoreMember]` members get serialized and int keys become string keys. `[Union]` on T is also unsupported, because abstract types are rejected with MsgPack021. The new attribute's XML docs and the README section document this always-contractless behaviour, which contradicts the acceptance criterion. Ledger L19 says to follow the requirement here.

receipt_plan.detail: Run tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests/Receipts/GeneratedFormatterHonoursAttributesTests.cs. HonoursMessagePackObjectAttributesOnFormattedType checks that a member marked [IgnoreMember] does not appear in the generated formatter. HonoursDataContractOnFormattedType checks that a member without [DataMember] on a [DataContract] type does not appear. Both are expected to fail on head.
